brief:
Summary: Former CIA counter-terrorism officer John Kiriakou talks with host Joe Rogan about replacing Mike Baker in Athens, tracking down al-Qaeda operative Abu Zubaydah in Pakistan after 9/11, and refusing to participate in the CIA's enhanced interrogation techniques (torture program).
People: Joe Rogan; John Kiriakou; Mike Baker; Andreas Papandreou; Abu Nidal; Osama bin Laden; Ayman al-Zawahiri; Abu Zubaydah; Khalid Sheikh Mohammed
Context: John Kiriakou, a former CIA counter-terrorism officer and whistleblower, is interviewed by host Joe Rogan on 'The Joe Rogan Experience' podcast (Episode #2392).
Unclear: The identities of the masked boss on the transport plane, the senior official who offered Kiriakou enhanced interrogation training in the cafeteria, and the executive floor officer who advised him against entering the program are not explicitly named in the text.
